items.source: For use with instance-based registration of filters.
items.translation: 用于基于实例的过滤器注册。

items.source: The target bean must implement the standard Servlet Filter interface.
items.translation: 目标 Bean 必须实现标准的 Servlet Filter 接口。

items.source: Return the name of the ServletContext attribute which should be used to retrieve the WebApplicationContext from which to load the delegate Filter bean.
items.translation: 返回用于从其中加载委托 `Filter` Bean 的 ServletContext 属性的名称，以检索该WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Set the name of the ServletContext attribute which should be used to retrieve the WebApplicationContext from which to load the delegate Filter bean.
items.translation: 设置用于从其中加载委托 `Filter` Bean 的 `WebApplicationContext`（org.springframework.web.context.WebApplicationContext 接口）的 ServletContext 属性名称。

items.translation: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - 如果由 Filter 抛出

items.source: The given WebApplicationContext may or may not be refreshed when passed in. If it has not, and if the context implements ConfigurableApplicationContext, a refresh() will be attempted before retrieving the named target bean.
items.translation: 给定的 `WebApplicationContext` 在传入时可能已刷新，也可能未刷新。如果尚未刷新，且该上下文实现了 ConfigurableApplicationContext，则在检索命名目标 Bean 之前将尝试调用 refresh()。

items.source: NOTE: The lifecycle methods defined by the Servlet Filter interface will by default not be delegated to the target bean, relying on the Spring application context to manage the lifecycle of that bean. Specifying the "targetFilterLifecycle" filter init-param as "true" will enforce invocation of the Filter.init(jakarta.servlet.FilterConfig) and Filter.destroy() lifecycle methods on the target bean, letting the Servlet container manage the filter lifecycle.
items.translation: 注意： 由 Servlet Filter 接口定义的生命周期方法默认不会委派给目标 Bean，而是依赖 Spring 应用程序上下文来管理该 Bean 的生命周期。将 "targetFilterLifecycle" 过滤器初始化参数指定为 "true" 将强制在目标 Bean 上调用 Filter.init(jakarta.servlet.FilterConfig) 和 Filter.destroy() 生命周期方法，从而让 Servlet 容器管理过滤器生命周期。

items.source: web.xml will usually contain a DelegatingFilterProxy definition, with the specified filter-name corresponding to a bean name in Spring's root application context. All calls to the filter proxy will then be delegated to that bean in the Spring context, which is required to implement the standard Servlet Filter interface.
items.translation: `web.xml` 通常包含一个 `DelegatingFilterProxy` 定义，其中指定的 `filter-name` 对应于 Spring 根应用程序上下文中的 bean 名称。随后对过滤器代理的所有调用都将被委托给 Spring 上下文中的该 bean，而该 bean 必须实现标准的 Servlet Filter 接口。

items.source: DelegatingFilterProxy can optionally accept constructor parameters when using a Servlet container's instance-based filter registration methods, usually in conjunction with Spring's WebApplicationInitializer SPI. These constructors allow for providing the delegate Filter bean directly, or providing the application context and bean name to fetch, avoiding the need to look up the application context from the ServletContext.
items.translation: DelegatingFilterProxy 在使用 Servlet 容器的基于实例的过滤器注册方法时，可选地接受构造函数参数，通常与 Spring 的 WebApplicationInitializer SPI 结合使用。这些构造函数允许直接提供委托 Filter Bean，或提供应用程序上下文和要获取的 Bean 名称，从而避免从 ServletContext 中查找应用程序上下文的需要。

items.source: This proxy's Environment will be inherited from the given WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 此代理的 `Environment` 将从给定的 `WebApplicationContext` 继承。

items.source: By default, the filter-name as specified for the DelegatingFilterProxy in web.xml will be used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，将使用在 `web.xml` 中为 DelegatingFilterProxy 指定的 `filter-name`。

items.source: This class was originally inspired by Spring Security's FilterToBeanProxy class, written by Ben Alex.
items.translation: 该类最初受 Ben Alex 编写的 Spring Security 的 `FilterToBeanProxy` 类启发。

items.source: Subclasses may override this method to provide a different WebApplicationContext retrieval strategy.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以提供不同的 WebApplicationContext 获取策略。

items.source: The default implementation fetches the bean from the application context and calls the standard Filter.init method on it, passing in the FilterConfig of this Filter proxy.
items.translation: 默认实现从应用程序上下文中获取该 Bean，并调用其标准的 `Filter.init` 方法，传入此 Filter 代理的 FilterConfig。

items.source:
This approach is particularly useful for Filter implementations with complex
setup needs, allowing to apply the full Spring bean definition machinery to
Filter instances. Alternatively, consider standard Filter setup in combination
with looking up service beans from the Spring root application context.
items.translation: 这种方法对于具有复杂配置需求的 Filter 实现特别有用，允许将完整的 Spring Bean 定义机制应用于 Filter 实例。或者，可以考虑使用标准的 Filter 配置方式，并结合从 Spring 根应用程序上下文中查找服务 Bean。

items.source:
Default is "false"; target beans usually rely on the Spring application
context for managing their lifecycle. Setting this flag to "true" means
that the servlet container will control the lifecycle of the target
Filter, with this proxy delegating the corresponding calls.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"；目标 Bean 通常依赖 Spring 应用程序上下文来管理其生命周期。将此标志设置为 "true" 意味着 Servlet 容器将控制目标 Filter 的生命周期，而该代理将委托相应的调用。

items.source:
Note: This method will be called from standard filter initialization
as well as filter bean initialization in a Spring application context.
Filter name and ServletContext will be available in both cases.
items.translation: 注意：此方法将在标准过滤器初始化以及 Spring 应用程序上下文中的过滤器 Bean 初始化时调用。在这两种情况下，均可获取过滤器名称和 ServletContext。

items.source: This default implementation is empty.
items.translation: 该默认实现为空。

items.translation: 注意：此方法将从标准过滤器销毁以及 Spring 应用上下文中的过滤器 Bean 销毁中调用。
